craft_notes: Sthāyin: denial-verse 1 (mirrors v3-4 as no). Rows: row 1 (not/not/not march). Close: nature (denied). Rejected: 'essence' — killed: nature (svabhāva-sense); softening denial — killed: these are the same four candidates now refused.

lines: Not nine-self, not word-heap, not Bhairava —
not three-headed god, not power-triad's nature.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tattvato na navātmāsau śabdarāśir na bhairavaḥ | na cāsau triśirā devo na ca śaktitrayātmakaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Is it nine-self or word-heap? → Every creature-form is denied — Bhairava-form exceeds naming.
c1_essence: Not nine-self, not word-heap, not three-headed god.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
